description: Image Description: The image shows a round, single-tiered cake placed inside a cardboard box. The cake is frosted in a soft pink color with decorative white and light blue floral icing on top, including a prominent blue rose at the center. The cake's edge is adorned with a ruffled yellow border and small white pearl-like decorations along the sides. The words "Happy Birthday" are written in pink cursive icing across the surface of the cake. Numerous colorful candles—red, yellow, green
